toolsHub.title: Dev Tools
toolsHub.subtitle: Small utilities I keep needing. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is sent to a server.

base64.title: Base64 Encode/Decode
base64.description: Convert text to and from Base64.

hex.title: Hex Encode/Decode
hex.description: Convert text to and from hexadecimal.

caseConverter.title: Case Converter
caseConverter.description: Convert text between common case styles.

timestamp.title: Timestamp Generator
timestamp.description: Current time (or any input) in formats used by Java, Node, Python and more.
timestamp.placeholder: Unix seconds/millis or any parseable date — leave empty for now
timestamp.error: Could not parse that as a date/timestamp.

uuidGenerator.title: UUID Generator
uuidGenerator.description: Generate one or many UUID v4 values.

jwtDecoder.title: JWT Decoder
jwtDecoder.description: Decode a JWT's header and payload.
jwtDecoder.warning: Signature is NOT verified — this only decodes the header and payload. Never treat a decoded-but-unverified token as trusted.

errors.malformedToken: Not a valid JWT (expected 3 dot-separated parts).
errors.invalidEncoding: Could not decode token — malformed Base64URL or JSON.

hashGenerator.title: Hash Generator
hashGenerator.description: MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 digests of text.
hashGenerator.warning: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security purposes — use them only for checksums, not for passwords or integrity against a malicious actor.

diffChecker.title: Diff Checker
diffChecker.description: Compare files or blocks of text and see what changed.

certificateChecker.title: Certificate Checker
certificateChecker.description: Check a digital certificate's validity, issuer and revocation status.
certificateChecker.disclosureWarning: Unlike every other tool here, this one is not fully local: it sends the certificate to our server, which contacts the certificate's issuing authority to check its revocation status.

errors.invalidPem: That doesn't look like a valid certificate.
errors.invalidPfx: Could not read that file — check the password or try a different file.
errors.unexpectedError: Something went wrong while checking the certificate.
errors.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

reason.noOcspUrl: This certificate has no OCSP responder information — revocation status can't be checked.
reason.ocspRequestFailed: The OCSP request to the certificate issuer failed or returned no usable answer.
reason.issuerCertUnavailable: Could not obtain the issuer's certificate, needed to check revocation.
reason.noCrlUrl: This certificate has no CRL distribution point information — revocation status can't be checked.
reason.crlRequestFailed: Could not fetch or read the certificate revocation list (CRL).

csvYamlJson.title: CSV/YAML ↔ JSON
csvYamlJson.description: Convert between CSV, YAML and JSON.
csvYamlJson.placeholder: Paste CSV, YAML or JSON here...

errors.invalidCsv: Could not parse that as CSV.
errors.invalidYaml: Could not parse that as YAML.
errors.invalidJson: Could not parse that as JSON.
